### 3.2 Updating Node Region, Member Groups, or Capacity (`PATCH /api/v1/admin/nodes/{node_id}`)

**2026-11-03 — Restart with changed deny / host sets, at #403.** With
agent-core 36 (#401) on main, a restart on the same boot with a changed
`denied_v4`, `extra_denied_v4` or `host_v4` no longer adopts the previously
installed sets. Any growth, shrink or replacement refuses same-boot adoption:
the node takes its baseline, with member forwarding closed, and serves members
again only after its first full Apply, which installs the configured sets. A
busy node lock or a control timeout can delay that Apply; the node keeps the
baseline meanwhile, never the old sets, and no maximum delay is stated.
Unchanged sets, reordered or duplicated, still adopt. SIGHUP still does not
reload these fields. See the
[agent-core 36 dated hand-off](../node/followup36-restart-and-signals-2026-11-01.md).
Still open: sets changed underneath a running agent (live drift) are not
detected, because the verifier does not read these sets' elements; that check
is routed to netlab 27, and no workaround is promised.

**Known behaviour at #403 (r20 H-1, reported and routed, not yet judged).**
After such a restart, the bytes counted since the last sample before it can be
recorded as an unattributed `mapping conflict` usage gap instead of member
usage. See the [archived r20 review](../reviews/r20-adoption-signal-review.md).
The finding is routed to agent-core 37; no fix date is promised.

First fetch the node (`GET /api/v1/admin/nodes/{node_id}`) and capture the response `ETag` header (`"<resource_version>"`). Supply `If-Match` and `Idempotency-Key` (`428 Precondition Required` if `If-Match` is missing; `412 Precondition Failed` if stale):

`[Verified on dev/test stack]`
```bash
curl -fsS -X PATCH "https://vpn.example.com:8443/api/v1/admin/nodes/${NODE_ID}" \
  -H "Cookie: __Host-fvpn-admin=${ADMIN_SESSION}" \
  -H "X-CSRF-Token: ${ADMIN_CSRF_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Origin: https://vpn.example.com" \
  -H "If-Match: \"${ETAG}\"" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "tw-tpe-01",
    "region": "tw-tpe",
    "member_group_ids": [
      "01950000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001"
    ],
    "capacity": {
      "down_bps": "900000000",
      "up_bps": "900000000",
      "member_down_bps_cap": "100000000",
      "member_up_bps_cap": "100000000"
    }
  }'
```
*(To clear an explicit capacity ceiling and revert to policy defaults, send `"clear_capacity": true` and omit `"capacity"`. Updating `member_group_ids` or `capacity` increments `desired_config_generation` and returns `202 Accepted` with a `node.update` operation; metadata-only changes to `name` or `notes` return `200 OK`. In the Admin Portal (`#235`, `apps/portal/src/pages/admin/AdminNodeDetailPage.tsx`), `/admin/nodes/{id}` caches the `ETag` from `202 Accepted` responses and shows the saved banner only after the post-save refetch settles.)*

### 3.3 Publishing, Disabling, and Unpublishing Exits (`PUT /api/v1/admin/nodes/{node_id}/publication`)

Exit publication controls whether member devices route traffic through the node (`§5.2`, `§7.3`, `D-057`, `docs/nodes/WIRING.md`):
- `"published"`: Creates/enables the NetBird exit route (`0.0.0.0/0`) and `member-to-exit` policy for the exit's attached `exit_groups` (`group_ids` / `member_group_ids`), and sets `publication_intent: "published"` in the node's signed desired state. Requires the node to have a valid incarnation, `provisioning_state = "ready"`, an approved serving release (`409 MINIMUM_VERSION_VIOLATION` or `409 STATE_CONFLICT` otherwise), and non-empty `exit_groups` so `netbird_route_readback` can complete.
  - **Atomic group attachment (`D-057`, `exits.SetPublicationTx`):** `PublicationRequest.group_ids` is persisted atomically under the node/exit locks and `If-Match` alongside the publication intent, single generation/version advance, operation, outbox event, and `exit:<uuid>` audit row. Omitting `group_ids` preserves existing membership, `[]` clears it, and a non-empty array replaces it (`422` with `/group_ids` detail if any group UUID is unknown). `NodeDetail` exposes the sorted membership in both `group_ids` and `member_group_ids`. A group disappearing after validation also returns `422 VALIDATION_FAILED`, detail path `/group_ids`, message `unknown group`; the entire membership/publication transaction rolls back. Refresh the groups and node ETag before correcting and resubmitting.
- `"disabled"`: Temporarily removes the node from member exit routing (`node.disable`) while keeping the node enrolled and online for diagnostics or updates.
- `"unpublished"`: Withdraws the exit publication (`node.unpublish`).

`[Verified on dev/test stack]`
```bash
curl -fsS -X PUT "https://vpn.example.com:8443/api/v1/admin/nodes/${NODE_ID}/publication" \
  -H "Cookie: __Host-fvpn-admin=${ADMIN_SESSION}" \
  -H "X-CSRF-Token: ${ADMIN_CSRF_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Origin: https://vpn.example.com" \
  -H "If-Match: \"${ETAG}\"" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "publication_intent": "published",
    "group_ids": [
      "01950000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001"
    ],
    "reason": "Exit readiness checks verified"
  }'
```
Poll the returned operation and node detail; completion requires `status == "succeeded"` and `publication_observed == "active"`. A failed operation needs investigation, not indefinite polling.

If publication returns `422 NODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE` before creating an operation, inspect readiness, capacity, and baseline checks first.

**Publication `data_path_probe`, zero-binding rule, and attachment basis (`SECOPS-11`, `#148`, `#160`, `internal/nodes/publication_evidence.go`, `internal/nodes/publication_gate.go`, `internal/exits/publication_gate.go`, `docs/nodes/WIRING.md`):** `data_path_probe` fails with `NODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE` unless the current incarnation's selected observation satisfies `PublicationForwardingEvidence` for the issued signed `DesiredStateEnvelope` at the acknowledged generation:

1. The agent reports `member_forwarding_enabled: true`, `provisioning_state: ready`, `data_health: healthy`, `safety_status: passed`, `tunnel_probe: passed`, and a nonzero `applied_config_generation` at least as new as the operation's requested generation.
2. **With one or more `device_bindings` in the signed envelope:** `lease.lease_id` must be a nonzero UUID with `lease.expires_at` in the future, and `lease`, `qos`, and `source_binding` must all report `passed`.
3. **Zero-binding published generation (`device_bindings: []`, `#148`):** When the current incarnation's issued signed envelope (`desired_state_envelopes.payload->'signed'`) at the acknowledged generation has `publication_intent = "published"` and an explicit empty `device_bindings` list (`[]`), `lease`, `qos`, and `source_binding` may be `passed` or `not_run` and no armed member lease is required. Any check reporting `failed` still blocks publication (`check_failed`).
4. **Publication attachment basis, first-populated-generation gate, and `D-074` gated `node.publish` waiting state (`#160`, `#224`, `D-074`, `internal/nodes/publication_gate.go`, `internal/exits/publication_gate.go`, `docs/nodes/WIRING.md`):**
   - Before a `node.publish` operation completes, `RecordPublicationAttachmentTx` records `publication_attachment_state` and `publication_attachment_basis` (`empty_exception` when the acknowledged signed envelope had `device_bindings: []`, or `populated_verified` when it had one or more `device_bindings`) in `operations.observed_refs`.
   - **Gated `node.publish` waiting state (`D-074`, `#224`, `internal/nodes/publication_gate.go`, `docs/nodes/WIRING.md`):** When a `node.publish` operation stays `running` with `agent_policy` or `data_path_probe` in `status: "pending"`, `error_code: "NODE_NOT_SERVICEABLE"`, and `message: "member_forwarding_unconfirmed (lease_unconfirmed)"`, central is waiting for the node to apply the latest compiled configuration generation and report passing serving checks (`exits.publication_observed` remains unchanged, or `"withdrawn"` if an empty-exception route was withdrawn first); the step clears automatically on the next qualifying observation and worker pass, and transitions to `status: "failed"` (`publication_observed: "error"`) only if the worker retry budget (`worker_attempts` = 10 attempts, ~4.3–8.5 minutes of jittered exponential backoff from 1s to 300s) is exhausted, at which point you should verify node health and re-issue `PUT /api/v1/admin/nodes/{node_id}/publication`.
  D-107 (#287) appends the bounded cause for admin and node readers in revision 13 `Operation.steps[].message`; see the [dated publication diagnostics note](../nodes/2026-10-31-publication-gate-cause.md). D-074 is unchanged: held publication stays `running`; a polling timeout is not a failure. Display the diagnostic string directly, without interpreting it as a new reason enum. D-101 (#275) closed Portal CI red since #259 by obtaining a real serving lease via `POST /api/v1/agent/lease-renewals`; fixtures never fabricate lease evidence.
   - **What `publication_observed = 'withdrawn'` with cause `member_forwarding_unconfirmed` means and how it clears:** When the most recent succeeded `node.publish` operation used `empty_exception` and the first populated desired-state generation (`device_bindings` non-empty) is compiled, `QueuePublicationGateTx` queues a `node.publish` operation under `system:publication-gate` via `node.publication_changed`. While the node's observation is still on an older generation (`stale_generation`) or lacks passing `lease`, `qos`, and `source_binding` checks (`serving_checks_unconfirmed`), `failGatedPublish` under the per-node advisory lock (`fvpn:publication:<node_id>`) withdraws the NetBird route (`WithdrawExit`), confirms its absence or disabled state via `ReadExitState`, sets `exits.publication_observed = 'withdrawn'` while keeping `publication_intent = 'published'` (recording the fixed failure cause `member_forwarding_unconfirmed` with the specific gate reason in the step `reason`, bounded retry, and a D-029 `node.publish` transition audit on `exit:<id>` under `system:publication-gate`), and `CheckPublicationDelivery` withholds the populated desired-state envelope with retryable `503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE` (`"Publication route verification pending."`) until withdrawal is confirmed. Once withdrawal is confirmed, the node fetches and applies the populated desired-state generation and submits an observation with passing `lease`, `qos`, and `source_binding` checks; observation progress then queues a fresh recovery `node.publish` operation under `system:publication-gate` that re-attaches and reads back the NetBird route, transitions `exits.publication_observed` back to `'active'` (with a D-029 `node.publish` audit), and establishes `publication_attachment_basis = 'populated_verified'`.
   - **`populated_verified` attachments never block delivery:** Once `populated_verified` is recorded, this gate never withdraws the route and never blocks `GET /api/v1/agent/desired-state` (`200 OK`), including when adding a second binding or revoking a device while NetBird is unavailable.
5. **Operation step `reason` vocabulary (`internal/nodes/publication_evidence.go`, `#243`):** When `data_path_probe` is held in `pending` (`D-074`, `#224`) or fails after retry exhaustion, the step's `observed.reason` (and admin step `message`) records one bounded cause alongside the fallback `member_forwarding_unconfirmed`: `forwarding_disabled`, `stale_generation`, `tunnel_not_passed`, `check_failed`, `serving_checks_unconfirmed`, `isolation_unconfirmed`, `readiness_unconfirmed`, or `lease_unconfirmed` (`publicationForwardingFailure` in `#243` evaluates `check_failed` before `forwarding_disabled` so a node with `member_forwarding_enabled: false` and a failed `lease`, `qos`, or `source_binding` check such as `AWAITING_MEMBER_GRANTS` reports `check_failed`).
6. **Agent heartbeat `forwarding.reason`, reading the provisional window (`D-067`, `D-071`), lease `Retry-After`, host preflight, `VerifyServing` whole-ruleset & `D-079` loopback rules (`#220`, `#241`), bounded `conntrack -D` retries, revoke `nodes` step outcomes (`D-070`, `#217`), one-shot stale-generation grace (`#217`, `#228`), and `NodeDetail.usage_outbox` (`#226`, `#232`, `#238`, `#243`) (`#146`, `#156`, `#159`, `#162`, `#164`, `#166`, `#172`, `#191`, `#193`, `#194`, `#196`, `#197`, `#198`, `#200`, `#202`, `#206`, `#213`, `#216`, `#217`, `#220`, `#223`, `#226`, `#228`, `#232`, `#238`, `#241`, `#243`, `docs/node/README.md`, `docs/nodes/README.md`, `docs/portal/README.md`, `docs/poc/G2-netlab.md`, `node/agent/revocation.go`, `node/agent/decide.go`, `node/agent/plane.go`, `node/agent/sync.go`, `node/enforce/apply.go`, `node/enforce/verify.go`, `node/enforce/verify_foreign.go`, `internal/leases/leases.go`, `internal/nodes/nodes.go`, `internal/nodes/observations.go`):**
   - In `ObservationReport.forwarding.reason`, the node agent reports `policy_missing` when desired state is missing/unverified/expired/unpublished or when the stored lease is missing or belongs to another generation (in which case the `lease` check reports `STALE_GENERATION`), reports `awaiting_member_grants` (`D-067`, `D-071`, `#191`, `#198`, `#200`, `#213`, `#216`) when the stored lease for the applied generation is still inside its anchored monotonic deadline (`leaseInForce`) with `members: []` while `DesiredState.device_bindings` is non-empty, and reports `lease_expired` only when the anchored monotonic deadline of the lease for the applied generation has passed (other reasons: `safety_check_failed`, `check_failed`, `meter_unavailable`, `update_in_progress`, `recovery_required`). Revision 11 (`#213`, `#216`) names that provisional state `AWAITING_MEMBER_GRANTS`: the node lease for this generation is inside its anchored deadline and `config_generation` equals the desired generation, but `lease.members` is empty while desired `device_bindings` is non-empty. `safety_status` stays `passed`. The `lease` check is `failed` with `error_code: AWAITING_MEMBER_GRANTS` and detail `Serving lease has no member grants yet.`; `qos` and `source_binding` are `failed` with `error_code: AWAITING_MEMBER_GRANTS` (not `VALIDATION_FAILED`) and details `Rate policy could not be applied.` and `No member binding was admitted.`; `errors` carries exactly one entry `code=AWAITING_MEMBER_GRANTS`, `stage=lease`, `message=Serving lease has no member grants yet.`. This is not a deadline failure and not a malformed policy. A passed deadline stays `lease_expired` / `LEASE_EXPIRED` (`Serving lease is not in force.`). A generation mismatch stays `policy_missing` / `STALE_GENERATION`. An empty desired `device_bindings` list carries neither reason nor this code. The step that applies a new desired generation requests a serving lease immediately when the stored lease's `config_generation` differs, without waiting for the renewal lead window, and admits bare IPv4 `allowed_ipv4` addresses in lease bindings as `/32`.
   - **Reading the provisional window (`D-067`, `D-071`, `#191`, `#193`, `#194`, `#198`, `#200`, `#201`, `#206`, `#213`, `#216`, `#223`, `node/agent/sync.go`, `node/agent/decide.go`, `internal/leases/leases.go`, `internal/nodes/nodes.go`, `internal/nodes/observations.go`, [`docs/portal/README.md` §6](../portal/README.md#6-operator-node-detail-notes-provisional-lease-waiting-copy--identity-conflict-d-067-d-071-d-072)):** A node that just restarted or just got published may receive a grant-less lease (`members: []`) from central (`RenewTx`, which includes member grants only when `lifecycle_state == "registered" && publication_intent == "published" && provisioning_state == "ready"`; `#194` also preserves `provisioning_state = "ready"` across concurrent generation advances once initial readiness is achieved) while `DesiredState.device_bindings` is non-empty. During this provisional window, the node reports the `lease`, `qos`, and `source_binding` checks as `failed` with `AWAITING_MEMBER_GRANTS`, one `errors[]` entry at `stage=lease` (`code: AWAITING_MEMBER_GRANTS`, `message: "Serving lease has no member grants yet."`), block reason `awaiting_member_grants` (`forwarding_block_reasons: ["awaiting_member_grants"]`), `safety_status` `passed`, and `data_health` `healthy`. When `fvpn-agent` holds an accepted grant-less lease, including before desired bindings arrive, the agent treats it as **provisional** and renews after **one heartbeat**, then **doubling**, capped at **`60 s`** (`provisionalRenewalMaxInterval = 60 * time.Second`, stopping when a lease with member grants arrives), and central (`RenewTx` in `internal/leases/leases.go`, `leases.ProvisionalGrantlessLeaseSeconds = 60`, `D-067` backstop, `#206`) expires such a grant-less lease after **`60 s`** (`expires_at = issued_at + min(max_offline_seconds, 60s)`) as a central expiry backstop; populated serving also requires publication, eligibility, readiness and responsive control (`44 s` measured in `#201`, resolving `F4-01`) — not after the `24 h` lease window. **This is not an incident; `LEASE_EXPIRED` / `lease_expired` is.** (See [`docs/portal/README.md` §6](../portal/README.md#6-operator-node-detail-notes-provisional-lease-waiting-copy--identity-conflict-d-067-d-071-d-072) for how the Admin Portal renders this waiting state on `/admin/nodes/{id}`, `#223`.) If `AWAITING_MEMBER_GRANTS` / `awaiting_member_grants` persists beyond a few minutes, check desired bindings (`device_bindings` and exit group attachments) and the member's entitlement (`service_state: "active"` and an active subscription or finite grant), then check `fvpn-worker` (`outbox_events` and worker readiness/logs) and whether the node has reached `provisioning_state = "ready"`.
   - **D-087 (#250): every accepted grant-less lease has a renewal schedule, even before desired bindings arrive. The first request slot is one heartbeat after the empty lease (capped at 60 s), then doubling, never more than 60 s of local waiting between requests; the lease renewal lead can bring a slot forward. A populated lease additionally needs a published generation with eligible member bindings, accepted readiness, and a responsive control service. A scheduled request slot is not completed I/O: ongoing work, request latency and server `Retry-After` can delay completion. Empty bindings do not stop renewal.**
   - **Single-attempt lease renewal and `Retry-After` (`#162`, `#166`, `node/internal/controlclient/api.go`, `node/agent/sync.go`, `node/agent/decide.go`):** `controlclient.Client.RenewLeaseOnce` returns `StatusError` (`RetryAfter`, `RetryAt`) immediately while `Client.RenewLease` waits out `Retry-After` without a second request. The agent calls `RenewLeaseOnce` at most once per step (`e.leaseAttempted`) and honours `Retry-After` via monotonic `e.leaseRetryAt` (`Input.LeaseRetryPending`) without blocking heartbeats or observations. Under `#166`, when the node already holds a verified, unexpired lease for the applied generation (`leaseInForce == true`), a `Retry-After` backoff **keeps `member_forwarding_enabled: true` (`serving`)**, reports the `lease` check as `status: "passed"` with `detail: "Lease renewal is waiting for Retry-After."`, and keeps the local watchdog heartbeat `serving`. Only when no fresh lease exists for the applied generation (for example, on the initial lease request for a new generation) does `LeaseRetryPending` report the `lease` check as `failed` (`error_code: RATE_LIMITED`, `detail: "Lease renewal is waiting for Retry-After."`) and withhold forwarding (`policy_missing`).
   - **D-085 live serving verification (#260, #264):** The agent verifies live nft/tc state three times per serving step: before reconciliation, after Apply before the ACK, and before the heartbeat. Each read has a budget of `min(1 s, min(heartbeat, poll)/2)`. The lab host measurement was **52.6 ms per serving step**; this is not a hardware guarantee. A rejected read withdraws serving with the specific reason and never acknowledges the offered generation. `ErrorCode.TC_FOREIGN_FILTER` is now the real 500-class, non-retryable, node-local code (#261): a foreign tc filter on a member-facing link fails the serving gate. D-093: a shared error-code enum change is a behavior change for every lane that looks codes up dynamically.
   - **D-090 containment boundary (#262):** `enforce.Quarantine(ctx, executor, model)` withdraws serving, installs and verifies the no-probe baseline, sets every member-facing link of the applied model administratively down, never deletes foreign tc objects, and persists recovery intent as an empty owned nft set `quarantine_<interface>` in `inet fvpn`. Agent-core follow-up 22 (#272) wires it at `rejectServing` through the Apply executor. Retained applied models survive baselines and restart as containment evidence only; live and Apply-triggered failures retain sanitized evidence. **Member links are administratively down until a clean verified Apply**. Clearing containment and restoring serving additionally require a passing member-path check (D-096: hashes of the pre-Apply local topology and the applied peers’ member route). Live lab: zero bypass packets after quarantine, control path still working. Another privileged daemon (NetBird) may raise a member link between steps: re-containment on the next step is proven, uninterrupted containment is not. Uplink filters are outside member-link containment. Netlab follow-up 14 (#285) now measures D-096 on the native IPv4 NetBird-owned path; D-108 keeps NetBird as the route/address owner while the agent waits. Installer-owned transit and IPv6 configurations remain outside that closure. D-100: topology expectations refresh only through a clean verified Apply of a newer published generation; no out-of-band override.
   - **Host prerequisites, `VerifyServing` whole-ruleset & `D-079` loopback rules (`#220`, `#241`), bounded `conntrack -D` retries, revoke `nodes` step outcomes (`D-070`, `#217`), and one-shot stale-generation grace (`#217`, `#228`) (`#156`, `#159`, `#162`, `#164`, `#166`, `#172`, `#193`, `#194`, `#196`, `#197`, `#202`, `#206`, `#216`, `#217`, `#220`, `#228`, `#241`, `node/agent/plane.go`, `node/agent/revocation.go`, `node/internal/agentstore/store.go`, `node/enforce/apply.go`, `node/enforce/verify.go`, `node/enforce/verify_foreign.go`, `internal/nodes/nodes.go`, `internal/nodes/observations.go`, `docs/nodes/README.md`, `docs/poc/G2-netlab.md`):**
     - `SystemPlane.MissingExecutables()` (`#162`, `#166`) uses `enforce.Executor` directly to preflight `nft`, `tc`, and `ip` and calls `enforce.RequireConntrack(p.exec)` at startup before installing the boot baseline; a missing binary keeps forwarding off with `safety_check_failed`, logs only the executable name, and reports `DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE` at stage `preflight` plus failed `lease`, `qos`, and `source_binding` checks (`DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE`).
     - **Whole-ruleset nftables read-back, foreign-chain verification (`#220`, `r14` M-3), and `D-079` loopback-scoped foreign rules (`#241`, `node/enforce/verify_foreign.go`, `node/enforce/doc.go`, [`docs/poc/G2-netlab.md`](../poc/G2-netlab.md)):** `VerifyServing` reads the **whole** host nftables ruleset (`nft -j list ruleset`), not only `table inet fvpn`. A base chain outside `inet fvpn` on `prerouting`, `forward`, or `postrouting` in families `ip`, `ip6`, `inet`, or `bridge`, or on `ingress` or `egress` of the member ingress (`MemberIf`) or uplink (`UplinkIf`) device (including a `netdev` or `inet` `ingress`/`egress` chain with no device), that can rewrite payloads (`mangle`), set `meta mark` or `ct mark` (fails with `MARK_SEMANTICS_VIOLATED`), disable conntrack (`notrack`), NAT (`snat`, `dnat`, `masquerade`, `redirect`, `nat`), `queue`, `drop`, `reject` (or has chain policy `drop` or `reject`), offload via `flow`/`xt` or attach a foreign `flowtable` to `MemberIf`/`UplinkIf` (fails with `FLOWTABLE_BYPASS`), or `jump`/`goto` into a chain containing any of those statements (or has no priority, an unknown hook, or an unresolvable jump target — fails with `ISOLATION_POLICY_INVALID`), fails serving verification closed (`member_forwarding_enabled=false`, `safety_status=failed`) with verification reason `ISOLATION_POLICY_INVALID`, `MARK_SEMANTICS_VIOLATED`, or `FLOWTABLE_BYPASS` (detail: `table <t> family <f> hook <h> priority <p> chain <c> statement <s>`, or with rule handle `table <t> family <f> hook <h> priority <p> chain <c> handle <n> statement <s>` when the rule carries a nonzero handle). Under **`D-079` (`#241`, `w1-netlab` follow-up 11, `node/enforce/verify_foreign.go`, [`docs/poc/G2-netlab.md`](../poc/G2-netlab.md))**, a foreign rule whose native `ip` or `ip6` `saddr` or `daddr` payload match (single address, prefix, address range, or anonymous set of addresses/prefixes/ranges) lies **entirely inside loopback** (`127.0.0.0/8` for `ip`, `::1/128` for `ip6`) cannot match member transit traffic (`100.64.0.0/10`) or non-loopback uplink traffic; `VerifyServing` classifies that rule as **`loopback_scoped`** in `VerifyResult.Loopback` (`[]LoopbackEvidence{Table, Family, Chain, Hook, Priority, Handle, Statement}`) instead of failing closed as `FLOWTABLE_BYPASS`. By contrast, `xt` matches and table/chain names (`DOCKER_OUTPUT`, `DOCKER_POSTROUTING`) prove nothing, `jump`/`goto` targets are still walked unless the jump rule itself is loopback-scoped, and any non-loopback NAT or packet rewrite on a crossed hook still fails closed (`FLOWTABLE_BYPASS`, `ISOLATION_POLICY_INVALID`, or `MARK_SEMANTICS_VIOLATED`) with `handle <n>` in the detail. Foreign tables and chains that only match, count (`counter`), `log`, `accept`, or `continue` are tolerated at any priority, as are `input` and `output` chains, family `arp`, and `ingress`/`egress` chains bound to devices other than `MemberIf` and `UplinkIf`. **Operator consequence:** host firewall managers (`ufw`, `firewalld`) and Docker or any other NAT for non-loopback traffic must **not** run on a production exit node (`loopback_scoped` in read-back evidence is informational).
     - `VerifyServing` (`#172`, `node/enforce/verify.go`, `node/enforce/parse_nft.go`) accepts only the rendered model inside `inet fvpn`: every `accept` rule in `forward` must be a verified serving accept (member DNS to `@resolver_v4:53` after upload `@allowed_v4` drop, per-device upload/download accept after `@denied_v4` and `@host_v4` drops, or download `ct state established,related` after download `@allowed_v4` drop) or a verified probe accept (`ct state related` counts as established; upload and download `@allowed_v4` drops are tracked separately; `@resolver_v4` exact match, `@denied_v4`/`@host_v4` drops, and non-53 drop `ctbadns` to `@resolver_v4` are required with or without a probe; only chains `{forward, input, output, postrouting}` are allowed in `inet fvpn` keyed by `(family, table, name)` with duplicates rejected; `input` accepts before drops and `interval` flags on `allowed_v4`, `probe_v4`, `probe_dst_v4`, and `resolver_v4` are rejected). `Render` (`#172`) unconditionally merges `Datapath.SNAT/32` into `@host_v4` and unions `SpecDeniedV4()` with `ExtraDeniedV4` (when the node's uplink sits on a public on-link L2 subnet, the operator must include that prefix and gateway IP in `ExtraDeniedV4`).
     - In `enforce.Apply` (`#156`, `#159`, `#172`, `#196`, `#197`, `#202`, `#216`), after `VerifyServing` and `VerifyQoS` succeed, `Apply` populates `verified.Counters` and `verified.Samples` (`Samples` skips unbound devices and zero metadata) before running the `m.Revoke` loop, and attempts `deleteConntrack` (`conntrack -D -s <ip>` and `conntrack -D -d <ip>`) for every address in `m.Revoke` before returning `*ConntrackDeleteError{Pending, Failed}` (`ApplyResult.Verified = true`), where revocation entries are keyed by `(addr, device_id, member_id)` (`RevokedAddress` / `revocationKey`), `mergeRevocations` (`#202`) retains only the addresses in `Failed` alongside any unattempted addresses so already-deleted flows are not re-deleted when a sibling address fails, and an address in local SQLite `applied_address` that was migrated with nil `DeviceID`/`MemberID` and later reassigned to a non-nil `(DeviceID, MemberID)` binding is queued for `conntrack -D` (`#216`) so pre-existing flows cannot survive reassignment.
     - **How to interpret `ISOLATION_POLICY_INVALID` on a serving vs. non-serving node, the 12-attempt fail-closed bound, revoke `nodes` step outcomes (`D-070`), and the exit-group + `90 s` freshness fence (`#164`, `#166`, `#193`, `#194`, `#202`, `#206`, `#217`):** When `plane.Apply` returns `res.Verified == true` alongside a conntrack delete failure (`enforce.IsConntrackDeleteFailure(err)`) and consecutive failed attempts remain below 12 (`1..11`), the verified nftables ruleset has already removed the revoked bindings from `@allowed_v4` and drops their upload and download packets ahead of `ct state established,related accept`. Therefore, `fvpn-agent` (`#166`) **keeps the verified serving ruleset installed (`member_forwarding_enabled: true`, local heartbeat `serving`, and `internet_only`, `qos`, `source_binding`, and `meter` checks `passed`)**, persists the failed `(addr, device_id, member_id)` entries under `pending_revocations` in local SQLite `meta` (merged with any newly dropped addresses on later generations and retried on every apply tick until `conntrack -D` succeeds), and reports one `NodeError` in `ObservationReport.errors` with `code: ISOLATION_POLICY_INVALID`, `stage: "apply"`, and `message: "conntrack delete pending; serving ruleset verified"`. By contrast, after **twelve consecutive failed `conntrack -D` attempts** (`maxConntrackDeleteAttempts = 12`, persisted across restarts in `#193` and `#202`) or immediately when the `conntrack` binary is missing after preflight (`exec.LookPath("conntrack")` error), `fvpn-agent` fails isolation closed and installs the baseline (`plane.ApplyBaseline`): operators see `member_forwarding_enabled=false`, `safety_status=failed`, `forwarding_block_reasons=["safety_check_failed"]`, and `internet_only=failed` with `error_code: ISOLATION_POLICY_INVALID` (detail `"Conntrack delete exceeded the retry bound."` or `"Conntrack is not installed."`), or when another revision-8 enforcement verification code (`GENERATION_MISMATCH`, `HOOK_PRIORITY_MISMATCH`, `COUNTER_ORDER_INVALID`, `FLOWTABLE_BYPASS`, `DEVICE_CLASS_MISSING`, `QOS_CLASS_MISSING`, `MARK_SEMANTICS_VIOLATED`, `PROBE_UNBOUNDED`, `METER_PATH_INVALID`, `ISOLATION_BASELINE_MISSING`, `METER_EPOCH_CHANGE`) appears on a failed `source_binding`, `qos`, `lease`, `internet_only`, or `meter` check with `member_forwarding_enabled: false` (`safety_check_failed`), ruleset or QoS verification failed and the agent withdrew to the fail-closed baseline without acknowledging the generation or renewing the lease. On central (`SubmitObservation` in `internal/nodes/observations.go` and `ackRevokeOperationsTx` / `ObserveRevokedDeviceCutoffTx` in `internal/nodes/nodes.go`, `D-070`, `#194`, `#206`, `#217`), a device revoke operation's `"nodes"` step waits **only** on registered exits that **actually serve the member** (a shared exit group through the exit's publication `exit_group_ids`, the member's groups `member_group_ids`, or the member's active entitlement grants `entitlement_grants` / plan revision `plan_revisions`) and are **fresh** (`control_status = 'online'`, observed within `DefaultStaleTimeout = 90 s` on both `last_observed_at` and `last_seen_at`); **stale or ungrouped/unrelated nodes never hold a revoke** (`#217`, `r14` H-1; if no registered exit shares an exit group with the member or no carrying exit has a fresh online observation within `90 s`, the `"nodes"` step stays `"pending"` with `reason = "awaiting_serving_exit_observation"`), and across the fresh serving exits it records one of three bounded `observed.reason` outcomes:
       1. **`conntrack_delete_pending`**: recorded (`status = "running"`, `observed.reason = "conntrack_delete_pending"`, with a `node.revoke_isolation_pending` audit) while the node still forwards under the 12-attempt retry bound (`member_forwarding_enabled = true`, `safety_status = "passed"`, all checks `passed`, and `{code: "ISOLATION_POLICY_INVALID", stage: "apply"}` in `errors`).
       2. **`conntrack_delete_succeeded`**: recorded (`status = "succeeded"`, `observed.reason = "conntrack_delete_succeeded"`, `isolation_verified = true`, with a `node.revoke_isolation_resolved` audit) on a clean observation (`applied_config_generation >= desired_config_generation`, `safety_status = "passed"`, `provisioning_state = "ready"`, and no `ISOLATION_POLICY_INVALID` apply error).
       3. **`node_failed_closed`**: recorded (`status = "succeeded"`, `observed.reason = "node_failed_closed"`, `isolation_verified = true`, with a `node.revoke_isolation_resolved` audit) when the node's real fail-closed shape arrives after twelve failed `conntrack -D` attempts or a missing `conntrack` binary (`applied_config_generation >= desired_config_generation`, `member_forwarding_enabled = false`, `safety_status = "failed"`, `forwarding_block_reasons` contains `"safety_check_failed"`, check `internet_only` is `"failed"` with `error_code = "ISOLATION_POLICY_INVALID"`, and `{code: "ISOLATION_POLICY_INVALID", stage: "apply"}` is still in `errors`).
       A second registered node of the exit group still reporting a pending `{code: "ISOLATION_POLICY_INVALID", stage: "apply"}` error while forwarding holds the `"nodes"` step in `running` (`conntrack_delete_pending`) until every fresh (`control_status = 'online'`, observed within `90 s`) registered node of the exit group has either succeeded (`conntrack_delete_succeeded`) or failed closed (`node_failed_closed`).
     - **One-shot stale-generation grace (`#217`, `#228`, `r14` M-2, `D-075`, `db/migrations/00187_identity_roaming_and_readiness_grace.sql`, `internal/nodes/observations.go`, [`docs/nodes/README.md`](../nodes/README.md)):** Once an incarnation reaches `provisioning_state = "ready"`, a `safety_status = "passed"` observation for an older configuration generation (`observed.applied_config_generation < desired_generation`) keeps `provisioning_state = "ready"` **once per generation change**; the next consecutive stale report for that same `(desired_generation, applied_config_generation)` pair degrades `provisioning_state` to `"applying"`. Under **`D-075` (`#228`, migration `00187_identity_roaming_and_readiness_grace.sql`)**, the one-shot grace mark lives in the domain column **`node_incarnations.stale_generation_grace_at`** (set to `observed_at` in the same transaction that grants the grace, and cleared to `NULL` when the incarnation applies a generation `>= desired_config_generation` or is downgraded to `"applying"` / `"failed"`), and `SubmitObservation` (`staleGenerationGraceAvailableTx`) checks `stale_generation_grace_at IS NULL` so **readiness and grace decisions never read `audit_events`** (replacing the `#217` `staleGenerationGraceAvailableTx` audit read, while `stale_generation_grace: true` remains in the `node.observation_applied` audit event payload as informational metadata).
     - **Live usage outbox status in observations and `NodeDetail.usage_outbox` (`SECOPS-19`, `D-075`, `D-077 §2`, `#226`, `#232`, `#238`, `#243`, `db/migrations/00189_node_incarnation_usage_outbox.sql`, `node/agent/usage_status.go`, `internal/nodes/nodes.go`, `internal/nodes/observations.go`, [`docs/node/README.md`](../node/README.md), [`docs/nodes/README.md`](../nodes/README.md), [`docs/node/usage-store.md`](../node/usage-store.md)):** Each `ObservationReport` (`POST /api/v1/agent/observations`) carries `ObservationReport.usage` (`UsageOutboxStatus`) read from the open local usage store (`state_dir/usage.db`, `(*usagestore.Store).OutboxStatus` under a `2 s` `usageStatusBoundDefault` bound): `ledger_epoch` (which stays `null` until a verified recovery checkpoint `ApplyCheckpoint` has been accepted, even when `central_acked_through > 0`, `#232`), `meter_epoch_id`, `last_durable_event_seq`, `central_acked_through`, `blocked_seq`, `unacked_event_count`, `unacked_payload_bytes` (`unacked_payload_bytes`), `oldest_unacked_at`, and `acked_archive_bytes` (sending the zero shape before the store is open or when a read fails, reusing the last successful status from the process on a `2 s` deadline timeout, logging `usage status available` or `usage status unavailable: <reason>` once per state transition, and never evaluating or persisting `gate_stopped` — which is evaluated only by `meter.Health` -> `EvaluateGate` on the agent run loop, `#232` — or adding an `errors[]` entry or changing `safety_status`, `provisioning_state`, or member forwarding). On `main` (`#226`, `#238`, `#243`, migration `db/migrations/00189_node_incarnation_usage_outbox.sql`), central stores `ObservationReport.usage` both inside `node_observations.report_payload` and on `node_incarnations.usage_outbox` JSONB + `usage_outbox_observed_at` in `SubmitObservationTx` whenever a non-stale report carries a `usage` block (the agent's zero shape is projected as zeros; a later report without a `usage` block leaves it intact; a new incarnation starts with `usage_outbox: null` — never absent), and projects **`NodeDetail.usage_outbox`** (`UsageOutboxStatus` fields + `observed_at`) on `GET /api/v1/admin/nodes/{node_id}` participating in the node strong `ETag` (`"<resource_version>"`, `304 Not Modified` on `If-None-Match`; operators can also read the node's local SQLite ledger directly via `fvpn-agent usage snapshot -config /etc/vpn-node/agent-run.json [-json]`, `#225`, `#232`).

Production exit nodes must not run Docker or any other NAT for non-loopback traffic. D-079 `loopback_scoped` evidence is informational; `xt` matches and chain/table names prove nothing. Native loopback scope must be demonstrated by the verifier. See [calibration §1.7](calibration.md).
